name: Do I need a lawyer if the dog owner is a friend or family member?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a lawyer if the dog owner is a friend or family member?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, even if the dog owner is a friend or family member, it is often advisable to consult with a lawyer. A lawyer can help navigate the complexities of an insurance claim, ensuring you receive fair compensation without straining personal relationships. The claim is typically against the dog owner's homeowner's insurance policy, not directly against them personally, which helps keep personal ties intact while securing necessary medical coverage and other damages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a lawyer can help navigate insurance claims against a friend or family member's policy, protecting your rights without damaging personal relationships.
